metadata.chapter_subtitle: Why computers matter even when the real idea is still geographic

inventory.summary: The original draft had the right thesis but needed a clearer distinction between model and tool and a more explicit explanation of when computers become necessary.
issues: Needed stronger conceptual separation between the model and the computer.
Needed smoother transitions across repetition, simulation, and data handling.
Needed a more useful reader-facing diagnostic routine.

rewrite.summary: Rewrote the full chapter to keep the geographic idea central while explaining exactly what the computer adds.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Added a practical diagnostic question sequence.

qa_review.summary: The revised chapter is clear, concept-first, and appropriate for first-time readers entering computational work.

repair.summary: No further repair was needed after the rewrite.
actions_taken: Confirmed that the chapter stays conceptually grounded instead of becoming tool-centric.

design_review.summary: The chapter uses examples and classification of tasks as explainers, which is the right pedagogical design for this topic.
improvements_made: Improved the chapter's interpretive scaffolding with a diagnostic reading routine.
